# Refine: Tim44 interface in 8E1M restricted to the biological partners (Tim17 chain A, Tim23 chain B);
# chains H and L are the Fab used for cryo-EM and are excluded. Statistical test of conservation enrichment.
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H_={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
def txt(u):
    r=requests.get(u,headers=H_,timeout=120); r.raise_for_status(); return r.text
B62_txt="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rows=B62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aal=rows[0].split(); IDX={c:i for i,c in enumerate(aal)}
Bm=np.full((21,21),-4.0)
for line in rows[1:]:
    p=line.split()
    for j,x in enumerate(p[1:]): Bm[IDX[p[0]],IDX[aal[j]]]=float(x)
enc=lambda s: np.array([IDX.get(c,20) for c in s])
def sc(a,b): return Bm[IDX.get(a,20),IDX.get(b,20)]
def nw_fast(s1,s2,go=-11.0,ge=-1.0):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-1e9
    S=Bm[np.ix_(enc(s1),enc(s2))]
    Mp=np.full(m+1,NEG);Xp=np.full(m+1,NEG);Yp=np.full(m+1,NEG);Mp[0]=0.0
    for j in range(1,m+1): Yp[j]=go+ge*(j-1)
    ptr=np.zeros((n+1,m+1,3),np.int8); ptr[0,1:,2]=2; ar=np.arange(m)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        M=np.full(m+1,NEG);X=np.full(m+1,NEG);Y=np.full(m+1,NEG)
        X[0]=go+ge*(i-1); ptr[i,0,1]=1
        c=np.vstack([Mp[:-1],Xp[:-1],Yp[:-1]]); k=np.argmax(c,0); M[1:]=c[k,ar]+S[i-1]; ptr[i,1:,0]=k
        c=np.vstack([Mp[1:]+go,Xp[1:]+ge,Yp[1:]+go]); k=np.argmax(c,0); X[1:]=c[k,ar]; ptr[i,1:,1]=k
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            cc=(M[j-1]+go,X[j-1]+go,Y[j-1]+ge); kk=int(np.argmax(cc)); Y[j]=cc[kk]; ptr[i,j,2]=kk
        Mp,Xp,Yp=M,X,Y
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((Mp[m],Xp[m],Yp[m]))); A=[];Bb=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=ptr[i,j,0];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: A.append(s1[i-1]);Bb.append('-');ns=ptr[i,j,1];i-=1;st=ns
        else: A.append('-');Bb.append(s2[j-1]);ns=ptr[i,j,2];j-=1;st=ns
        if i==0 and j>0 and st!=2: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0 and st!=1: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bb))
def mapping(ref,qry):
    A,B=nw_fast(ref,qry); i=j=0; mp={}
    for x,y in zip(A,B):
        if x!='-': i+=1
        if y!='-': j+=1
        if x!='-': mp[i]=(j if y!='-' else None,x,y)
    return mp
accs={"WORM":"O02161","YEAST":"Q01852","HUMAN":"O43615"}
seqs={k:"".join(txt(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta").strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,v in accs.items()}
mp_y=mapping(seqs["YEAST"],seqs["WORM"]); mp_h=mapping(seqs["HUMAN"],seqs["WORM"])
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse_all(t):
    out=[]
    for l in t.split("\n"):
        r=l[:6].strip()
        if r in ('ATOM','HETATM'):
            if l[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
            try: out.append(dict(rec=r,name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],resi=int(l[22:26]),
                                 xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])])))
            except ValueError: continue
    return out
ats=parse_all(txt("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8E1M.pdb"))
t44=[a for a in ats if a['ch']=='C' and a['resn'] in AA3]
part={'A':'Tim17','B':'Tim23'}
prot_o=[a for a in ats if a['ch'] in part and a['resn'] in AA3]
lip=[a for a in ats if a['resn'] in ('CDL','PTY')]
oxyz=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in prot_o]); ometa=[(a['ch'],a['resi'],a['resn']) for a in prot_o]
lxyz=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in lip]); lmeta=[(a['resn'],a['ch'],a['resi']) for a in lip]

cont={}; lipc={}
for a in t44:
    d=np.linalg.norm(oxyz-a['xyz'],axis=1)
    for i in np.where(d<4.5)[0]:
        ch,ri,rn=ometa[i]
        cont.setdefault(a['resi'],{}).setdefault(part[ch],set()).add(f"{AA3.get(rn,'X')}{ri}")
    if len(lxyz):
        dl=np.linalg.norm(lxyz-a['xyz'],axis=1)
        for i in np.where(dl<4.5)[0]:
            lipc.setdefault(a['resi'],set()).add(lmeta[i][0])

seqY=seqs['YEAST']
def cons_of(ri, mp):
    q=mp.get(ri)
    if not q or q[0] is None: return "no-equivalent", "gap"
    return ("identical" if q[1]==q[2] else ("similar" if sc(q[1],q[2])>0 else "different")), f"{q[2]}{q[0]}"
rows=[]
for ri in sorted(cont):
    c,w=cons_of(ri,mp_y); ch,wh=cons_of(ri,mp_h)
    rows.append([f"{seqY[ri-1]}{ri}", ";".join(f"{k}({','.join(sorted(v))})" for k,v in sorted(cont[ri].items())),
                 w,c, wh, "lipid:"+",".join(sorted(lipc.get(ri,[]))) if ri in lipc else ""])
iface=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["yeast_Tim44","partner_contacts_8E1M","TIN44_equiv","cons_vs_yeast","(human->worm check)","lipid_contact"])
print("=== Yeast Tim44 residues contacting Tim17/Tim23 in the cryo-EM core TIM23 complex 8E1M (Fab chains excluded) ===")
print(iface.to_string(index=False))
n=len(iface); ni=(iface.cons_vs_yeast=='identical').sum(); ns=(iface.cons_vs_yeast=='similar').sum()
alln=[r for r in mp_y if mp_y[r][0] is not None]
bgi=sum(1 for r in alln if mp_y[r][1]==mp_y[r][2])
print(f"\ninterface residues n={n}: identical {ni} ({100*ni/n:.0f}%), similar {ns} ({100*ns/n:.0f}%), different {n-ni-ns}")
print(f"background over all {len(alln)} aligned yeast positions: identical {bgi} ({100*bgi/len(alln):.1f}%)")
tab=[[ni,n-ni],[bgi-ni,(len(alln)-bgi)-(n-ni)]]
odds,p=fisher_exact(tab)
print(f"Fisher exact (interface identical vs rest): OR={odds:.2f}, p={p:.3f}")
# identical+similar
nsim=ni+ns; bgsim=sum(1 for r in alln if sc(mp_y[r][1],mp_y[r][2])>0)
odds2,p2=fisher_exact([[nsim,n-nsim],[bgsim-nsim,(len(alln)-bgsim)-(n-nsim)]])
print(f"identical-or-similar: interface {nsim}/{n} = {100*nsim/n:.0f}% vs background {bgsim}/{len(alln)} = {100*bgsim/len(alln):.0f}%; OR={odds2:.2f}, p={p2:.4f}")
# split by partner and by domain
for dom,lo,hi in [("Tim44 NTD (107-230)",107,230),("Tim44 CTD (231-431)",231,431)]:
    sub=iface[[lo<=int(x[1:])<=hi for x in iface.yeast_Tim44]]
    if len(sub):
        print(f"  {dom}: n={len(sub)} identical {100*(sub.cons_vs_yeast=='identical').mean():.0f}% identical-or-similar {100*sub.cons_vs_yeast.isin(['identical','similar']).mean():.0f}%")
print("\nTim44 residues contacting cardiolipin (CDL) or phosphatidylethanolamine (PTY) in 8E1M:", sorted(lipc.items()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.4))
res=[int(x[1:]) for x in iface.yeast_Tim44]
colmap={'identical':'#2f855a','similar':'#dd6b20','different':'#c53030','no-equivalent':'#4a5568'}
ax.scatter(res,[1]*len(res),c=[colmap[c] for c in iface.cons_vs_yeast],s=60,marker='|',linewidths=3)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xlim(100,440)
ax.set_xlabel('yeast Tim44 residue (8E1M numbering)')
ax.set_title('Conservation in C. elegans TIN-44 of the Tim44 residues that contact Tim17/Tim23\n'
             f'green identical ({ni}), orange similar ({ns}), red different ({n-ni-ns}); background identity {100*bgi/len(alln):.0f}%')
for lo,hi,lab,col in [(107,230,'N-terminal domain','#9ae6b4'),(231,431,'C-terminal NTF2-like domain','#90cdf4')]:
    ax.axvspan(lo,hi,alpha=.25,color=col); ax.text((lo+hi)/2,1.25,lab,ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0.6,1.4)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
